items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: That's Paul Vaughn. Paul Vaughn, Sidney Correa, and... ... places.

ctx.x: You didn't play at all in that banjo chorus. Manetta told you that? Huh? Manetta told you that?
No. The recording man. The recording man. He told him, don't play too loud. Who's that? Oh? That's Paul Vaughn. Paul Vaughn, Sidney Correa, and... ... places. Man on that too. Man on that too.
